question: ‘The Test of My Life’ is an autobiography of which of the following cricketer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuvraj Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Test of My Life**

 
 
• About the author: Yuvraj Singh the author of “The Test of My Life: From Cricket to Cancer and Back” was known as the bad boy of Indian Cricket but at the same time was the most loved cricketer after Sachin Tendulkar. Yuvraj has played well and many times he had proven his position as a top player.
 
• Yuvraj Singh, who successfully battled lung cancer a few years ago, has come up with his ideas in this book and overcoming what actually means.
